title: What Happens If You Pop A Pimple?
description:
What Happens If You Pop A Pimple?

Squeezing does not empty a pimple - it shoves the pus deeper, and the danger triangle on your face drains toward your brain. Here is what actually happens, and the only fix that works.

Full sources:
- NHS, 'Acne', Health A to Z (page last reviewed 22 September 2026): acne happens when hair follicles become blocked with excess oil and dead skin cells; bacteria can grow in blocked follicles and cause inflammation and pus; advice 'do not pick or squeeze spots because this can cause scars'; pharmacist treatments include benzoyl peroxide
- Nemours KidsHealth, 'Should I Pop My Pimple?' (medically reviewed October 2018): 'Squeezing can push the pus deeper into the skin, which might cause more swelling and redness. Squeezing also can lead to scabs and might leave you with permanent pits or scars.'; 'To dry a pimple up faster, apply 5% benzoyl peroxide gel or cream once or twice a day.'
- Cureus 18(7):e112359 (2026): central-facial 'danger triangle' infections drain via valveless veins toward the cavernous sinus; intracranial complications are uncommon but carry significant morbidity

Not medical advice - sources linked for every claim.
Your body keeps score. #shorts
